title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_miniaturiste_by_jessie_burton_hiiw9 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_miniaturiste_by_jessie_burton_hiiw9' is identified as malicious software. Installation or execution of this package results in a fully compromised system, potentially allowing an attacker full control. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of compromise, complete remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised system.
